title: Libraries and Utilities Technical Reference
summary: Shared-code review is stricter because a small change can affect startup, requests, pipelines, imports, jobs, events, and tests.

sections.heading: Checklist
items: Owner, consumers, purpose, input/output, determinism, side effects, and complexity.
Explicit context, dependencies, errors, trace propagation, security, and performance.
Extension, compatibility, deprecation, and migration policy.
Positive, invalid-input, boundary, error-propagation, concurrency, performance, and consumer-regression tests.
